subject: Compliance RFI & network sequestration options — post-demo next steps
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Clare Ng <clare@medilink.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance RFI & network sequestration options — post-demo next steps

Hi Clare / Medilink team,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time and the walkthrough of your use case. Quick recap of the security/compliance topics we covered and suggested next steps so we have alignment: 

What you asked for / we flagged:
- SOC 2: you asked for our current report and expected timeline for the next audit window.
- GDPR/HIPAA: clarification on data residency, processing flows, and availability of a BAA.
- Private deployment options: VPC peering, PrivateLink, and an on-prem/air-gapped alternative for PHI workloads.
- Network isolation: your security team asked for a simple sketch of network boundaries and minimal trust paths.

Immediate asks from Medilink:
- A vendor questionnaire / RFI to capture controls and evidence pointers.
- An initial network diagram from Redwood showing the private deployment options we discussed (VPC plus optional air-gap staging).

Proposed Redwood next steps:
1) I will send our standard RFI template and a one-page topology sketch for the Private/VPC and air-gapped approaches (attachments).
2) Monica will prepare a short evidence checklist (SOC 2 outputs, encryption/KMS notes, audit log retention, BAA path).
3) Propose a technical follow-up (architecture review) week of Apr 5 — 45 minutes with your security/infra folks to walk the sketch and answer detailed questions.

Would Apr 6 or Apr 8 (midday PT) work for the architecture review? If you prefer, loop in your security alias and we can coordinate directly.

Thanks — I attached the RFI template and a rough topology sketch to start the conversation.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Subject: Re: Compliance RFI & network sequestration options — post-demo next steps

Hi Naomi — thanks for the clear recap.

This matches what we discussed. A few notes from our side:
- I'll put the RFI on our security queue; pls copy security@medilink.health for tracking (done).
- We will need a copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report or an attestation and confirmation of the next audit date.
- HIPAA / BAA: our legal team requires a path to a BAA; can you confirm whether Redwood provides a standard BAA and any required scoping language for Private deployments?
- For air-gapped options: we need to understand the work involved on our end (on-prem install vs. isolated VPC with data egress controls).

Initial timeline: we expect to return the completed RFI by Apr 8 if we can get the SOC 2 documentation and the topology sketch this week.

Proposed meeting: Apr 8, 10:00 AM PT works for our security lead (Evan). Can you confirm?

Thanks,
Clare
Director of Product & Integrations | Medilink Health
clare@medilink.health

Subject: Re: Compliance RFI & network sequestration options — internal next steps

Naomi — quick internal note and proposed evidence checklist for Medilink. I'll draft the RFI responses we can share publicly, but we should leave any sensitive artifacts for secure transfer: 

Required/or strongly requested items to offer:
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest) or SOC 2 readiness letter + next audit window.
- BAA: confirm availability and attach our standard BAA template.
- GDPR/HIPAA: data processing addenda / data residency commitments.
- Key management: KMS provider, customer-managed key option (Y/N), HSM support notes.
- Audit logs & retention: retention periods, log export options (SIEM integrations).
- Network boundaries: VPC design, minimal egress routes, PrivateLink / VPC peering options, and an air-gap deployment overview (high-level steps + responsibilities).
- Pen tests / vuln scans: summary and dates (do not attach full reports here).

Suggested attachments to send to Medilink now (non-sensitive): redwood-rfi-template.xlsx, a one-page topology sketch, and a short FAQ for Private deployments. Sensitive docs (SOC 2 full report, BAAs) should be shared via secure link (DocuSign/secure drive) once NDA/POC agreement stage is confirmed.

I'll assemble the draft answers by EOD today; Aditya, can you prepare the BAA + KMS blurb? Jordan, please pull the latest audit dates and the pen-test summary line for the RFI.

Monica
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
